feature.name: edit-existing-infra-ui-path
feature.summary: Add an Edit Infrastructure button to InstalledAppsPage that navigates to CustomInfrastructurePage with the selected app pre-filled via navigation store context, eliminating the need to manually interact with the AppSelector.

user_stories.as: an app owner viewing my installed apps
user_stories.i_want: an Edit Infrastructure button next to each app
user_stories.so_that: I can modify an existing app's modules without raising a support ticket

user_stories.as: an app owner who clicked Edit on an installed app
user_stories.i_want: the Custom Infrastructure wizard to open with my app already loaded
user_stories.so_that: I do not have to manually select app and environment from the dropdown

user_stories.as: a user who arrived at Custom Infrastructure via the Edit path
user_stories.i_want: a visible banner telling me I am editing an existing app
user_stories.so_that: I know this Deploy action will modify existing infrastructure, not create new

user_stories.i_want: a Clear and start fresh control
user_stories.so_that: I can abandon the edit and start a new infrastructure creation without navigating away

criteria: A pencil-icon button (fa-pencil-alt) appears in the action column for every app row on InstalledAppsPage
The button has title='Edit Infrastructure'
Clicking the button calls navigateToPage('custom', { appName: app.name, environment: app.environment })
The button is only rendered when VITE_ENABLE_CATALOG_PREFILL !== 'false'
navigateToPage signature is navigateToPage(page: PageId, context?: { appName: string; environment: string }): void
prefillContext ref is added to navigation store state and return object
navigateToPage('custom', { appName: 'myapp', environment: 'sand' }) sets prefillContext.value = { appName: 'myapp', environment: 'sand' }
navigateToPage('home') with no context sets prefillContext.value = null
All 18 existing call sites (8 files) compile and run without modification
On mount, if navigationStore.prefillContext is non-null and prefillEnabled is true, getAppMetadata(appName, environment) is called automatically
handlePrefill(metadata) is invoked with the API result
A loading indicator is shown during the auto-load
If the auto-load fails, step0Error is set and an error banner is displayed at Step 0
After consuming the context, navigationStore.prefillContext is set to null
AppSelector is collapsed (not expanded) after a successful auto-load
A banner reading 'Editing existing app: {appName} / {environment}' is rendered below the page header
The banner is only shown when prefillContext was present at mount time
The banner includes a 'Clear and start fresh' button
Clicking 'Clear and start fresh' resets isEditingMode, selectedModules, rbacRelationships, currentStep, and prefillData to their initial state
When VITE_ENABLE_CATALOG_PREFILL === 'false', the Edit button does not render in InstalledAppsPage
When VITE_ENABLE_CATALOG_PREFILL === 'false', the auto-load block in CustomInfrastructurePage onMounted is skipped
The computed prefillEnabled in InstalledAppsPage mirrors the same import.meta.env check as CustomInfrastructurePage
Edit button has aria-label='Edit infrastructure for {appName} in {environment}'
Editing mode banner has role='status'
'Clear and start fresh' is a focusable keyboard-operable button element
All new elements pass axe-core accessibility checks in component tests

api_endpoints.purpose: Fetch existing app metadata to pre-populate the Custom Infrastructure wizard

data_contracts.prefill_context_validation: alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores only, max 64 chars — regex: /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/

component_changes.description: Add optional context param to navigateToPage; add prefillContext ref to store state and return object. Clear prefillContext to null when context is absent.
component_changes.new_signature: navigateToPage(page: PageId, context?: { appName: string; environment: string }): void
component_changes.new_state: prefillContext: Ref<{ appName: string; environment: string } | null>

component_changes.description: Add prefillEnabled computed (mirrors CustomInfrastructurePage pattern). Add handleEditInfra(app) handler that calls navigateToPage with context. Add pencil-icon button to action toolbar, gated by v-if='prefillEnabled'.
ui_changes: Add Edit Infrastructure button (fa-pencil-alt, yellow colour) to app row action toolbar after Delete button
Button renders only when prefillEnabled is true

component_changes.description: Read navigationStore.prefillContext in onMounted. Validate appName/environment. Clear context immediately. Call getAppMetadata() and handlePrefill() on success. Collapse AppSelector via template ref. Set isEditingMode for banner display. Implement clearEditingMode().
new_functions: clearEditingMode(): void — resets isEditingMode, editingAppName, editingEnvironment, prefillData, step0Error, selectedModules, rbacRelationships, currentStep
component_changes.onMounted_addition: Read prefillContext, validate, clear context, set isEditingMode, call getAppMetadata(), invoke handlePrefill(), call appSelectorRef.collapse()
ui_changes: Editing mode banner below page header: 'Editing existing app: {appName} / {environment}' with role='status'
Clear and start fresh button in banner

component_changes.description: Add defineExpose({ collapse() }) so parent CustomInfrastructurePage can programmatically collapse the panel after auto-loading via navigation context. No prop, emit, or existing behaviour changes.

flows.name: Happy path: Edit from InstalledAppsPage
steps: User clicks Edit button on an app row in InstalledAppsPage
handleEditInfra(app) calls navigateToPage('custom', { appName, environment })
navigation.ts sets prefillContext = { appName, environment }, currentPage = 'custom'
App.vue renders CustomInfrastructurePage
onMounted reads prefillContext (non-null), validates format
prefillContext cleared to null immediately
isEditingMode = true; editingAppName/editingEnvironment captured for banner
isAutoLoading = true; editing banner and loading indicator shown
getAppMetadata(appName, environment) called via existing api.ts interceptor
handlePrefill(metadata) populates selectedModules and rbacRelationships
appSelectorRef.collapse() collapses AppSelector panel
isAutoLoading = false; user sees pre-filled wizard with editing banner

error_paths.handling: step0Error set with user-friendly message; isEditingMode = false; AppSelector stays expanded for manual recovery

error_paths.error: appName or environment fails regex validation
error_paths.handling: step0Error set; no API call; prefillContext already cleared

flows.name: Context leak prevention: navigate away and back
steps: User is on CustomInfrastructurePage (prefillContext already consumed and cleared to null)
User navigates to another page via navigateToPage('home')
navigation.ts: prefillContext = null (no context arg passed)
User navigates back to 'custom'
onMounted: prefillContext is null; no auto-load triggered; blank wizard shown

flows.name: Clear and start fresh
steps: User is in editing mode (isEditingMode = true)
User clicks 'Clear and start fresh'
clearEditingMode() called: isEditingMode = false, editingAppName/Env = null, prefillData = undefined, step0Error = undefined, selectedModules = [], rbacRelationships = [], currentStep = 0
Banner disappears; wizard resets to blank Step 0

error_scenarios.handling: Catch in try/catch; set step0Error with message; set isEditingMode = false; isAutoLoading = false
error_scenarios.user_message: Unable to reach the server. Please try again or use the Load panel below.
error_scenarios.logging: Handled by api.ts interceptor — emits api_request_failed telemetry with correlationId

error_scenarios.scenario: Invalid appName or environment in prefillContext
error_scenarios.handling: Regex validation before API call; set step0Error; clear prefillContext; return early
error_scenarios.user_message: Invalid prefill context: appName/environment must be alphanumeric (hyphens and underscores allowed, max 64 chars).
error_scenarios.logging: No API call made; no telemetry emitted

error_scenarios.scenario: prefillContext is null on mount (normal create path)
error_scenarios.handling: Auto-load block is skipped entirely; wizard initialises blank
prefillEnabled computed returns false; Edit button not rendered; auto-load block skipped
